modules.name: Source checklist
modules.description: The three source classes and the channel checklist within each. Always loaded when the skill runs.

modules.name: Search patterns
modules.description: How to search once inside a channel, abstraction chains, plus optional search engines. Always loaded when the skill runs.

modules.name: Source discovery log
modules.description: Staging log for newly-found channels/hubs, pending promotion into sources.md. Written to after a session, not read as search instructions.

planned.name: Session tracker
planned.description: Running plan/todo file so a long or repeated research session doesn't lose track of what's been checked.

planned.name: Findings memory
planned.description: Running log of past *findings* (distinct from source-log, which logs channels, not findings) so repeat runs on a similar topic don't re-surface the same thing as if it were new.

planned.name: Output formatter
planned.description: Reshape the final report into a user-specified style/format. Should hook into the environment's existing output-style preference mechanism rather than duplicating that mechanism inside this skill.
